name.description: The organization name. Every user has a `personal` organization for their own account.

slug.description: The organization slug. This will be your username for `personal` accounts.

type.description: The type of account this organization is. Will always be `personal` or `team`.

overages.description: The name of the organization. Every user has a `personal` organization for their own account.

require_mfa.description: Whether all members of the organization are required to have multi-factor authentication enabled.

blocked_reads.description: Returns the current status for blocked reads.

blocked_writes.description: Returns the current status for blocked writes.

plan_id.description: The pricing plan identifier this organization is subscribed to.

plan_timeline.description: The billing cycle for the paid plan, if any.

platform.description: The external platform this organization is managed by. Will be empty for Turso managed organizations.
